events.name: signup_start
events.signal: Matching signup page loaded once per navigation

events.name: generate_lead
events.signal: Verified CRM form submission or supported signed webhook

events.name: begin_checkout
events.signal: Verified handoff to the matching Stripe checkout

events.name: purchase
events.signal: Verified Stripe paid invoice or subscription webhook handled server-side
events.deduplication: Stripe event ID plus invoice ID

rules: No purchase event from a success-page visit.
No PII, full URLs, email, names or phone numbers in analytics.
Allowlist plan and billing fields; do not pass arbitrary query parameters.
No advertising pixels or session recording.
Verify consent and cross-domain attribution before activation.
